researchNotes: Keep the 2016–2018 loose movement distinct from racial supremacism. Claimed speech freedom and order preferences conflict; national identity is not evidence for inherited racial violence. Online activity does not settle biomedical ethics.

Use the specified Republican platform rather than every conservative. Electoral accountability, federalism, selective tariffs and AI expansion coexist with social-security commitments; no single pro-market or strong-president label resolves all questions.

Rothbard rejects state institutions, including elected ones. Private provision, contract and exchange remain categorical economic commitments, but rejection of a coercive government is not an endorsement of an international government or universal social approval.

Developmental executive concentration allows legally predictable procedures and delegated local experimentation. Singapore reference pluralism and selective skilled migration qualify blanket assimilation or closed borders; authoritarian capitalism is not total state ownership.

Preserve the owner-defined phrase and technological/national-power scope. Thiel is contextual evidence, not the definition. Christian family and embryo ethics constrain acceleration; Christian public values do not entail clerical vetoes, cancelled elections or racial hereditarianism.

The Baptist source expressly supports separation of church and state and rejects taxation to support faith. This qualifies Christian public moral influence. Family-role and marriage commitments remain strong, while dignity across races is distinct from a scientific theory of heredity.

The scoped CDU 2024 programme and social-market subsidiarity take precedence over assuming historical Catholic positions on every contemporary family question. Public guarantees, collective standards and federal institutions differ from state ownership or compulsory planning.

Tro och Solidaritet describes democratic openness, solidarity, diversity and universal welfare, while acknowledging differing abilities from birth. Its Christian lineage does not entail exclusive Christian legal authority; Nordic negotiated wages are not automatically a statutory minimum wage.

researchNotes: Christians on the Left combines Christian ethical influence with democratic socialism and freedom in community. Common ownership and solidarity do not imply clerical appointment or mandatory state-school conversion. Contemporary sexuality positions require qualified interpretation.

Smith allows public works and defence exceptions; Mill distinguishes representative deliberation, franchise qualifications and personal autonomy. These are counter-evidence to absolute private provision, every direct-democracy device and equating individual liberty with universal modern social attitudes.

Retain the CPC 2022–2026 governing-doctrine scope. The constitution protects private economic sectors within a socialist market economy. Party leadership, strategic planning and sovereignty coexist with formal representative procedures and specific medical-ethics restraints.

researchNotes: Use responsive democratic communitarianism, which balances autonomy with communal responsibility. The social self does not supply empirical genetic findings; shared participation does not require uniform culture, and democratic dialogue does not prescribe every referendum or recall mechanism.

One Nation representative institutions, ECHR protection and pragmatic mixed provision qualify blanket executive power, privatisation and moral restriction. Gradual reform can recognize diverse families while retaining continuity; referendum and recall mechanisms are separate institutional choices.

Distinguish hereditary head of state from accountable head of government. Parliamentary confidence and representative sovereignty do not imply a general binding citizen-repeal mechanism. A crown does not determine taxation, migration, ownership or biological explanations.

Cuba 2019 recognizes complementary private and cooperative ownership and a complementary market under socialist planning. PCC leadership differs from equal multiparty competition; the 2022 Family Code qualifies earlier family restrictions. Social provision often takes service rather than cash form.

Herder values linguistic-cultural plurality among peoples and rejects racial categorization. National culture can receive support without erasing minority identity; cultural self-expression does not prescribe a modern electoral constitution or a comprehensive economic plan.

DSA’s Workers Deserve More programme, drafted April–June 2026, specifies multiparty representation and broad voting rights but a judiciary subordinate to Congress. This directly qualifies independent constitutional judicial review. Socialization targets largest corporations and essential industries, not every enterprise.

Democratic ecosocialism favors participatory ecological planning and collective ownership, which need not be exclusively central-state ownership. Precaution is strong for irreversible ecological harms, while useful low-impact innovation remains compatible. Environmental policy does not settle human heredity.

Rio participation and precaution define the sustainable-development scope. Precaution supports strong scrutiny of irreversible risks, without dictating ownership or compulsory quotas. Environmental concern is not itself a position on human biological causes or cultural admission tests.

The 1927–1932 Italian doctrine explicitly repudiates democracy and pacifism; these strong positions remain supported. Corporatism recognizes private enterprise under direction. Lateran religious recognition is distinct from unlimited clerical government; do not import later Nazi racial doctrine.

Qutb’s divine sovereignty rejects autonomous secular legislation but also human rulers claiming unlimited sovereignty. Consultation and moral restrictions differ from experts or clergy having unfettered discretion. Private property, zakat and communal resources coexist; historical sex-role theories are disclosed rather than endorsed.

Separate PPP 1967–1977 democratic/socialist founding aims from Bhutto-era concentrated conduct used as counter-evidence. Islamic public reference does not establish clerical appointment. Nationalisation and land reform coexist with private activity and provincial constitutional recognition.

Use the Iranian Khomeinist constitutional variant, not all Muslims or Islamist schools. Islamic screening and supreme-jurist powers constrain elected institutions; public/cooperative/private sectors coexist. Recognized minorities and councils do not amount to unrestricted pluralism or regional sovereignty.

researchNotes: Kant’s representative republic need not be electorally chosen, restricts active franchise and denies a popular right of resistance. His federation is voluntary, not a coercive world state; hospitality is not a general settlement entitlement. Historical sexism and race theories are counter-evidence, not empirical findings.

Mouffe’s inclusive strategy treats opponents as legitimate adversaries and protects minority rights. This supports elections and plural contestation, but does not specify strongest support for each recall, judicial-review and referendum instrument. Anti-elite mobilisation is not unlimited majority authority.

The Australian Liberal Party platform protects constitutional democracy and federalism while favoring enterprise and targeted public provision. Historical party context does not decide every contemporary family or biomedical proposition; immigration, culture and trade need distinct judgments.

NOW’s equal participation, bodily autonomy and anti-stereotype commitments support strong equality positions. They do not establish every constitutional participation device, private/public ownership choice or neurological causal comparison. Disruptive protest, weapons and judicial safety controls are separate trade-offs.
sourcePublishers: International Center for Research on Women

researchNotes: Oxford–Andorra constitutional liberalism requires rights, opposition and legal checks, with disagreement over direct-democracy instruments. Civil liberties coexist with harm prevention and necessary public provision; liberalism is neither absolute pacifism nor a ban on voluntary tradition.
sourcePublishers: International Commission of Jurists / International Service for Human Rights

researchNotes: The LP’s explicit voluntary provision and exchange commitments justify strong economic responses. Representative and direct democratic safeguards are limited by individual rights. Property access qualifies obstructive protests; political choice does not guarantee every adherent’s social enthusiasm or a genetic doctrine.

The Spartacus programme elects councils through the adult working population of both sexes and gives recall rights; this is not an unrestricted all-citizen franchise or independent liberal judicial design. Luxemburg’s defense of dissent and condemnation of party dictatorship remain strong counter-evidence to personal autocracy.

New Democracy permits private capitalist production that does not dominate livelihoods and private peasant holdings before later socialist transformation. The 1927–1976 scope cannot silently erase this transitional exception. Party-led class participation differs from equal opposition access and independent courts.

Commune recall and workers’ participation differ from unrestricted liberal plural parties and courts. Gotha’s first phase permits unequal labor-linked returns and recognizes differing natural endowments; a socialist aim is not strongest support for every modern cash/compensation instrument.

Keep the selected democratic equal-opportunity ideal distinct from epistocracy. Competence-based employment selection does not remove voting rights or prove inherited racial differences; inheritance taxation can reduce unearned advantage without requiring full income equalization.

The selected military-priority scope emphasizes capability, mobilisation and force without defining an automatic coup or civilian family programme. Scholarship distinguishes militarism from any isolated military act. Human responsibility qualifies autonomous weapons; biomedical ethics is not inferred from weapons enthusiasm.

Nozick’s protective state permits police, courts and defense, with just rectification distinct from patterned redistribution. Neither minimal government nor voluntary communities prescribe one electoral design or universal social approval. Economic provision beyond protective functions remains private.
sourcePublishers: Basic Books; text reproduced by The Ted K Archive

researchNotes: The 2022 principles endorse constitutional democracy, public Christian heritage, free enterprise and strategic capacity. They defend private minority religious observance and favor federal variation with national intervention exceptions; this is neither clerical supremacy nor absolute local autonomy.

Dictatorship, racial exclusion, expansion and central Reich control are core and retain strong responses. Private firms operated under rearmament direction. Positive Christianity and church domination differ from clerical legal supremacy; false racial theories are recorded only as the ideology’s beliefs.

The Kristol/primacy school accepts limited welfare and public morality while promoting enterprise and active defense. Assertive foreign policy does not establish unlimited executive power; alliance leadership differs from surrendering national decisions to all international courts.

researchNotes: Hayek–Friedman–Buchanan support constitutionally limited democracy and markets but differ on social floors and monetary arrangements. Rights limits are not equivalent to unrestricted leaders. Public goods and strategic exceptions qualify absolute private provision or unconditional free trade.

The Nordic model combines private competitive production, public welfare and collective bargaining. Bargained wage floors are not synonymous with a nationwide statutory minimum wage. Parliamentary accountability does not prescribe universal recall or binding popular repeal; inherited churches can coexist with civil legal authority.

Rand’s government has protective police, court and army functions; commercial ownership and allocation remain laissez-faire. Majority choice cannot override rights. Voluntary experimentation is constrained by rights against harm; her conventional gender judgments qualify uniform contemporary progressivism.

Lyotard questions totalizing expert and progress narratives; Foucault criticizes discipline. These are philosophical orientations rather than a settled electoral or tax manifesto. Contestable plurality qualifies both majority sovereignty and universal central administration; anti-essentialism is not a quantitative genetic result.

Dewey’s participatory inquiry and later democratic socialist leaning qualify a categorical market/ownership reading. Democratic public life differs from a specified recall or judicial-veto mechanism. Experimentation emphasizes revisability, which cautions against irreversible clinical or ecological deployment.

Contemporary non-domination supports equal democratic contestation, while constitutional judicial review is expressly debated in republican scholarship. Public law can enable liberty and markets need anti-domination limits; neither unrestricted majority rule nor universal private ownership follows.

Use Reform UK’s 2024 contract, recovered from its current 2025 upload path. PR and constitutional accountability coexist with ECHR withdrawal and cultural restrictions. NHS funding promises do not require public facility ownership; calls for a PR referendum do not prescribe recall for every representative.

Voluntary communes and mutual aid reject both state monopolies and private capitalist domination. Tax-transfer and state-ownership questions fit poorly: responses describe the literal institutional proposal, not an invented midpoint ideal. Communal self-management is not election of a national government or mandatory state planning.

Hobhouse’s adult political participation and enabling social provision support representative democracy, with historically qualified citizenship language and emphasis on local organization. Social reform does not entail compulsory production quotas, absolute equal incomes or a contemporary doctrine for every family question.

Maintain the scoped social/worker-ownership philosophical ideal and pluralist institutional application. Cooperatives are not identical to government ownership; market socialism permits prices and producer autonomy. Economic commitments cannot automatically supply every constitutional instrument or social/biological policy.

The 1979 manifesto upholds parliamentary supremacy, mixed-economy limits and the NHS alongside privatization. Strong market commitments coexist with selected assistance and environmental concerns; economic decentralization does not imply protected constitutional regional vetoes.
sourcePublishers: Fordham University Internet Modern History Sourcebook

researchNotes: The Blair–Schröder text favors steering rather than rowing, entrepreneurial markets, work-linked welfare and lowest-practicable devolution. Equal opportunity differs from uniform incomes; technical modernization retains environmental responsibility. Democratic government does not specify every direct-democracy device.

Burkean/Kirkian prudence allows gradual correction while preserving inherited property and institutions. Moral fallibility is not a genetic ranking of races. Traditional continuity is stronger on family and gradual change than on universal clerical control, migration exclusion or technical prohibition.

The Transitional Programme’s soviet parties and class-based democracy do not promise equal competition for capitalist parties; factory and consumer control qualify bureaucratic command. International revolution differs from endorsing current interstate institutions. Tax and modern family questions are historical applications.

Herzl favors an aristocratic republic or democratic monarchy and explicitly excludes theocracy; Jewish self-determination does not specify liberal universal elections or secular removal of every inherited religious observance. Coordinated settlement, private enterprise and local groups coexist; later Israeli policy is not imported.
